2026-03-13.teaser: Today's collection reveals the hidden machinery behind our digital age, from the industrial-scale data harvesting powering AI's next frontier to intimate human stories that transcend technology. We're diving into corporate secrets, sporting legends, and the complex relationship between innovation and sovereignty. These pieces offer rare glimpses behind the curtain of how the future gets built — and who gets to decide its direction.

included.title: Nvidia's Massive AI Scraping Operation Revealed
included.summary: A leaked investigation reveals the staggering scale of Nvidia's AI training data collection through their Cosmos project. Internal Slack messages and documents show the company is scraping 80 years worth of video content daily — described internally as 'a human lifetime' of footage — to train their foundational AI models. The revelations expose how tech giants operate massive data harvesting operations despite internal legal and ethical concerns raised by staff members. The project received approval from Nvidia's highest levels of management, highlighting the corporate prioritization of AI advancement over privacy considerations. This investigation provides rare insight into the industrial-scale data collection that powers modern AI development, revealing the vast resources and questionable practices behind seemingly effortless AI capabilities. The story underscores growing tensions between rapid AI progress and ethical data use, as companies race to train more powerful models while navigating murky legal territories around content scraping. The leaked documents offer a window into how major tech corporations balance competitive advantage against potential legal and ethical risks in their pursuit of AI dominance.

included.title: Sarvam: Open is Not Sovereign
included.summary: This analysis examines the complex relationship between open-source AI development and technological sovereignty, using Sarvam AI as a case study. The piece challenges the common assumption that open-source automatically equals independence, arguing that true sovereignty requires more than just access to code and models. The author explores how dependency on foreign infrastructure, data, and talent can undermine claims of technological independence, even when using ostensibly 'open' systems. The argument delves into the nuanced reality of AI development, where sovereignty involves control over the entire stack — from hardware and cloud infrastructure to training data and specialized expertise. The piece highlights how countries and companies can fall into a false sense of security by adopting open-source solutions while remaining fundamentally dependent on foreign ecosystems. This perspective is particularly relevant as nations worldwide grapple with AI strategy and seek to balance openness with strategic autonomy. The analysis provides valuable insights for policymakers and technologists who must navigate the tension between leveraging global open-source innovations and maintaining meaningful control over critical AI capabilities. The piece contributes to broader debates about technology policy, digital sovereignty, and the true meaning of independence in an interconnected world.

included.title: Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova: A Story of Friendship Through Cancer
included.summary: This deeply moving piece chronicles the parallel cancer journeys of tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova, transforming their historic rivalry into a profound story of friendship and mutual support. The interactive feature details how both champions faced their diagnoses around the same time, drawing strength from each other despite their competitive past. Evert's ovarian cancer and Navratilova's throat and breast cancer battles are woven together in a narrative that transcends sports, exploring themes of vulnerability, courage, and human connection. The story reveals intimate details about their treatment experiences, fears, and the way their shared ordeal deepened their relationship beyond their famous on-court competition. Through candid interviews and personal reflections, the piece shows how two fierce competitors became each other's most important allies in fighting for their lives. The writing combines the drama of their tennis careers with the raw reality of cancer treatment, creating a powerful meditation on legacy, friendship, and what truly matters when facing mortality. The interactive format allows readers to experience their journey through multimedia elements, making their story more immediate and emotionally resonant. This piece stands out for its ability to find hope and beauty in the midst of serious illness while honoring the complexity of lifelong relationships.
